Definition: to be ashy, i.e. darkcolored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to mourn, be dark; 1a) (Qal) to be dark; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to darken; 1b2) to cause to mourn; 1c) (Hithpael) to grow dark
